scenes.title: Kenzo’s Initiation and the Missing Heart
scenes.rationale: The reunited party shares the initiation’s consequences and Bhishma’s message before beginning new exploration.
scenes.overview: Kenzo returns weakened and describes the missing heart that prevents Shakun reaching Karawa.
scenes.transitionToNext: Wellby begins scouting while the others recover.

scenes.title: Searching for a Way Inside
scenes.rationale: The short-rest scouting, courtyard investigation, and guarded entry are one continuous effort to explore the monastery and reach its records.
scenes.overview: A diary and enchanted materials lead into exploration of the fountain, warded doors, and ghostly guards.
scenes.transitionToNext: Entering the Hall draws the party into its stored memories.

scenes.title: The Hall of Stories
scenes.rationale: At the user’s request, the complete visit to the Hall stays together: learning to navigate its memories, discovering the lost expedition, confronting its despairing presence, and interpreting the clues before leaving.
scenes.overview: The party explores the memory web, learns of the eastern expedition and Rai’s promised aid, and struggles against the Hall’s despair.
scenes.transitionToNext: Growing despair and fading daylight prompt a retreat into the tower.

scenes.title: Scrolls Behind a Lightning Ward
scenes.rationale: Physical exploration replaces the memory search, with a trap, recovered scrolls, and a new occupied room at the top of the tower.
scenes.overview: The upper library’s ward injures the party, but the search yields Tongues, Sending, and Speak with Dead.
scenes.transitionToNext: Opening the top-floor bedroom reveals Karmana’s ghost.

scenes.title: Karmana’s Vigil and the Road Ahead
scenes.rationale: At the user’s request, the entire conversation with Karmana and the closing discussion of next steps form one final scene in the tower.
scenes.overview: Karmana explains Sajan and the growing danger; the party plans a temple visit, camp, Kharsan reconnaissance, and a return toward Karawa.
